file.content: // Custom node for mind-map style concept nodes // Features: double-click to create, inline edit, rounded rect

finding.pattern: onPaneDblClick handler for creating nodes at position useReactFlow().screenToFlowPosition for coordinate conversion useNodesState for adding nodes

technical_notes.note: Double-click on empty canvas creates new ConceptNode
Inline editing: input with autoFocus, Enter saves, Escape cancels
Style: rounded rectangle, accent color from 8-bit design

implementation_hints.hint: ConceptNode data structure: { label: string, color?: string }
Default position: center of current viewport
